title: Match countries to capitals: the world
intro: Match each capital city with its country in the world.

pairs.explain: Baku is the capital of Azerbaijan.
Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria.

Berlin is the capital of Germany.

Muscat is the capital of Oman.

Warsaw is the capital of Poland.
Belgrade is the capital of Serbia.
Mogadishu is the capital of Somalia.
São Tomé is the capital of Sao Tome and Principe.
San Salvador is the capital of El Salvador.
Damascus is the capital of Syrian Arab Republic.
Mbabane is the capital of Eswatini.
Ashgabat is the capital of Turkmenistan.
Dodoma is the capital of United Republic of Tanzania.
Washington, D.C. is the capital of United States of America.
